# Release packaging manifest, read by .github/scripts/release_build.py.
#
# Every file tracked at the release commit must match exactly one rule, otherwise the build fails: a new
# top-level file has to be classified here on purpose. Syntax: "include PATH" or "exclude PATH", where PATH is
# one file or DIR/** for a whole directory tree. Included paths must also pass _tools/framework_guard.py.
#
# Archives hold what the README's archive installation needs: the tools, the project template, public guides,
# the license and the root files that keep knowledge projects out of the framework Git index.
include .gitattributes
include .gitignore
include AGENTS.md
include CONTRIBUTING.md
include LICENSE
include README.md
include uv.toml
include _tools/**
include _template/**
include docs/**

# Development-only: CI, coverage, lint and release configuration. Never shipped.
exclude .github/**
exclude .coveragerc
exclude codecov.yml
exclude ruff.toml
